title: TestTwentySampleQuestions asserts only non-error + serializable, not answer correctness
evidence: soccer_test.go:307-323 — each of the 20 cases only checks err==nil, json.Marshal succeeds, non-nil, and <2s; it never asserts the returned counts/values
suggestion: Assert at least a few expected values (e.g. head-to-head totals, a known score) so the 20-question success criterion verifies behavior, not just liveness

title: Forward-position matching uses a hardcoded substring table
evidence: query.go:386 — strings.Contains("|ST|LS|RS|LW|RW|LF|RF|CF|", ...) enumerates forward codes inline; other position groupings (defenders/midfielders) are not supported
suggestion: Fine for the spec, but a named position-group map would be clearer and extensible

title: team_graph exposes a typed knowledge-graph traversal beyond the required tools
evidence: query.go:418-471 (*Store).Graph builds team/match/competition/player nodes and edges; matches the spec overview's 'knowledge graph interface' framing

title: Cross-source fixture dedup with retained raw provenance and cup-stage inference
evidence: data.go:227-343 merges duplicate fixtures within a 1-day window, keeps SourceRow provenance, and infers Copa do Brasil final/semi/quarter stages; TestPostponedFixturesAndCrossYearSeasons at soccer_test.go:341 verifies 380-match seasons

title: Strict input validation at the MCP boundary
evidence: main.go:56-69 decodeArgs uses DisallowUnknownFields; query.go:27-75 Filter.Validate rejects bad venue/date/limit/source; main.go:222-224 gates tool calls behind the initialize+initialized handshake
